end.summary:
Discussed Chipko, sacred groves, and ways communities protect nature.
Explained that tree roots help water soak into soil and reduce soil erosion.
Connected grass roots with less soil entering water.
Identified that children and colony members can also help protect trees and nature.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of Chipko, sacred groves, and community action, then used cause-and-effect questions about roots, water, and soil. Dev gave clear examples of how trees and grass protect soil and water, and later corrected the idea that only governments or kings can help nature. At home, ask Dev to explain one local action—such as planting or protecting a tree—and what it protects.
